prompt: List three features on your phone or laptop that learned from data. For each one, say what it predicts and what data it probably learned from.

criteria.label: Names three real features
criteria.look_for: three concrete features that plausibly learned from data (not fixed-rule tools like a calculator)

criteria.label: Says what each one predicts
criteria.look_for: for each feature, what it predicts or recommends

criteria.label: Names likely training data
criteria.look_for: for each feature, a plausible source of examples it learned from

reference: 1. Autocomplete predicts the next word I will type; it learned from large amounts of typed text. 2. The spam filter predicts whether an email is spam; it learned from emails people marked as spam. 3. Photo grouping predicts which photos show the same person; it learned from labelled photos of faces.
